title: The Chain
sentences: A giant chain across the harbor kept the Ottoman navy out.
The Byzantines stretched it across the mouth of the Golden Horn, floating on wooden logs.
It ran from the city to the far shore near Galata.
In 1453, the Ottoman fleet never broke through it.
Crusaders had got past it in 1203, by capturing the tower that held one end.
So Mehmed went around it, dragging ships over land.
Links said to come from it are shown in Istanbul museums today.
Follow for more from the fall of Constantinople.
